summary: Test the proposed real subset of the continued homogeneous model; distinguish biquaternionic representation from dynamical admissibility.

stage_events.description: The author questioned the complex-versus-biquaternion distinction and proposed seeking a compatible real subset using the inclusion of real numbers in complex numbers.

Clarified that the spin connection already has a biquaternionic complex-matrix representation. Substitution of a noncentral quaternion unit for a commuting coefficient is a different operator problem.

Within the unchanged positive-clock closed-FLRW ansatz, original readout gives a=cV, and the scale Euler residual is 1+c^2-Lambda*c^2*V^2. Proved that it cannot vanish at two distinct positive times; this is a scoped corollary of the existing concurrent-vector obstruction.
